title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF ANTIQUE FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE UNTIL AUGUST THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF ANTIQUE FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE UNTIL AUGUST THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE.

text.en:
The period for the payment, without penalty, of the land tax for the year nineteen hundred and live
in the Province of Antique is hereby extended to August thirty-first, nineteen hundred and five.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, June 9, 1905.
